facts.detail: Information is licensed UK-wide, royalty-free, perpetually and non-exclusively subject to the terms.

guard_streams.write_limit: Reuse permission does not validate coverage accuracy or archive identity.

facts.detail: Fixed API speeds are predictions supplied by leading UK ISPs.

facts.detail: The terms prohibit caching, aggregating or storing API information to construct a partial or complete dataset.
